scripts.ci:verify: npm run check:git-safety && npm run check:security && npm run check:docs && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix shared && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --prefix shared && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.lint: npm run check:docs && npm run check:security
